text:
eli (events): Quick thought  'Sips & Strings' after-work next Weds? potluck + tiny tasting table (wine + non-alc) + open-mic (5-7 min slots). spots: Office Commons, Rooftop Garden (covered?), Courtyard. start 6:00 or 6:30? RSVP + what youd bring (dish/drink/instrument). :guitar: :wine_glass: :banana:

morgan: love this! Rooftop if covered. 6:30 better for me. i can bring a small charcuterie (veg + cheese).

tess: Office Commons please  quieter mics. 6:00 works. ill bring a playlist and a cheap mic stand. no nuts in my dish pls. :headphones:

harry: happy to play a couple songs on guitar. 6:30 or 6 both ok. can also bring sparkling water + cups.

nina: courtyard would be cute but worry about weather. ill bring a batch of non-alc spiced cider if outside. allergic to shellfish FYI. :tropical_drink:

kai: i'm game. can do a 5-min poem reading if there's space. prefer 6:00.

eli (events): cool split. ill run a short ops-bot poll to pick spot/time. if Rooftop wins ill check cover/heaters; Office Commons ill reserve the corner sofa area + a mic; Courtyard ill arrange a couple picnic blankets and bug spray. also thinking of a tiny sign-up doc for slots so we don't run over (link after poll). :sparkles:

ops-bot: Poll: "Sips & Strings - pick spot & start time"  Rooftop Garden  2 votes  6:30  Office Commons  3 votes  6:00  Courtyard  1 vote (ends in 9h)

morgan: if Office Commons wins ill switch to bringing a fruit platter instead of charcuterie.

harry: adding tentative to calendar. also can bring an extra electric guitar amp if needed. :electric_plug:

tess: ill make a 8-slot sign-up sheet in the next message (short).

eli (events): lovely. if you havent voted, react to ops-bot poll or reply quick. ill post the sign-up link and a final plan by tomorrow noon. tiny rules: 5-7 min slots, keep instruments low, label dishes w/ allergen notes. see you for mellow tunes + snacks! :sparkles:
